Almost all Democrats disapprove of Trump's job performance: 4% approve and 95% disapprove, for a net approval of -91. This near-unanimous disapproval from Democrats has been the case for most of Trump's second term.

Trump's job approval among Independents has been falling. Currently 18% of Independents approve of Trump's job performance and 71% disapprove, a net job approval of -53. That's down from 32% approval and 60% disapproval (-28 net) among Independents at the start of the year. Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 19, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. The survey has garnered 124,759 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term.
